title: 第二十一章  连杀四人幕后黑手第二十二章  一击立功凶熊伏首
slug: 武道长生从边关猎户开始黄袍加身
lines: 第二十一章：连杀四人，幕后黑手
看着纸条上的文字，陆川瞳孔一缩，但依旧保持着镇定。
他的脑海中迅速回想，难道是沧海武馆发现是他杀死了马鸣，从而找人来报私仇？
但转念一想，在沧海武馆面前，他不过等同于喽啰，他们何必要假托其他人之手。
不做他想，陆川内心警惕到了极点。
为了防止是误会，陆川上山途中还特意拐到一条猎户们不常走的小道进山。
先前的猎户们亦步亦趋，远远缀在最后。
这一切让陆川已然明白，他们的目标哪是什么熊瞎子，而是自己！
但对方人多势众，就他一人，若是正面对拼，说不定会被射成筛子。
陆川因此不动声色，继续沿着既定的上山路线前进。
而后方，猎户郑满仓在众人最后，眯着双眼，不知道在想什么。
“石头哥，什么时候动手。”
猎户赵大强凑近了刘石头低声问道。
“等上山了再说，现在离山脚太近，动静大了，可能会引起其他人的注意。”
刘石头看着陆川的背影，强忍着直接一箭解决他的冲动。
就在这时，陆川转过一个拐角，瞬间消失在众人面前。
“人呢？快追！”
刘石头招呼着众人，顿时步伐快了不少。
“等等，各位兄弟，人有三急，你们先追上，我很快就来。”
郑满仓突然‘哎哟’一声，捂住了肚子。
刘石头见状，只得说道：
“满仓哥，你快点，如果人跟丢了，这钱可就没了。”
“好！好！兄弟们，你们先去。”
郑满仓停下脚步，看着众猎户狂奔，转瞬消失在他的眼前。
他这才放下捂着肚子的手，笑呵呵道：
“你们玩吧，虽然我郑满仓不是什么好货色，但是吧，还得还人一条命啊。”
正说着，他也不急着下山，左右看了几下，决定就在一重山打点野兔、野鸡，也算不枉上山一趟。
而此时，陆川在脱离众人视线后，左顾右盼一番，找到了他所要藏身的位置。
那是一株参天大树，树冠茂密，藏个人不在话下。
陆川手脚并用，只是片刻，便来到了树冠中。
他将整个身体以树木的枝叶遮挡，只露出一双锐利的双眼。
片刻后。
几道声音从周围骤响。
“MD，那小子人呢？”
“快找找！”
content_en:
Chapter 21: Killing four people in a row, the mastermind behind the scenes
Looking at the words on the note, Lu Chuan's pupils shrank, but he still remained calm.
He quickly recalled in his mind, could it be that Canghai Martial Arts School found out that he had killed Ma Ming and was looking for someone to take revenge?
But then I thought, in front of Canghai Martial Arts School, he was nothing more than a follower, why should they rely on others.
Not doing what he thought, Lu Chuan was extremely vigilant.
In order to prevent a misunderstanding, Lu Chuan deliberately turned onto a trail that hunters did not often take on the way up the mountain.
The previous hunters followed suit and were far behind.
All this made Lu Chuan understand that their target was not some blind bear, but himself!
But the other party has a large number of people, and he is the only one. If he fights head-on, he might be shot into a sieve.
Therefore, Lu Chuan remained calm and continued along the established route up the mountain.
In the back, Orion Zheng Mancang was at the end of the crowd, squinting his eyes and wondering what he was thinking.
"Brother Shitou, when will we do it?"
Orion Zhao Daqiang approached Liu Shitou and asked in a low voice.
"We'll wait until we get up the mountain. We're too close to the foot of the mountain now, and there will be too much noise, which may attract other people's attention."
Liu Shitou looked at Lu Chuan's back and resisted the urge to kill him with one arrow.
At this moment, Lu Chuan turned a corner and disappeared in front of everyone in an instant.
"Where's the person? Chase him!"
Liu Shitou greeted everyone, and his pace suddenly became much faster.
"Wait a minute, brothers, there are three emergencies. You should catch up first. I will be here soon."
Zheng Mancang suddenly said 'ouch' and covered his stomach.
When Liu Shitou saw this, he could only say:
"Brother Mancang, hurry up. If you lose me, the money will be gone."
"Okay! Okay! Brothers, you go first."
Zheng Mancang stopped and watched the hunters running wildly and disappearing in front of his eyes.
He then put down the hand covering his stomach and said with a smile:
"You guys go ahead and play. Although I, Zheng Mancang, am not a good guy, I still have to give someone a life."
As he said this, he was not in a hurry to go down the mountain. He looked around a few times and decided to catch some hares and pheasants on the first layer of the mountain. The trip up the mountain was not in vain.
At this time, after Lu Chuan was out of everyone's sight, he looked around and found the location where he wanted to hide.
It was a towering tree with a dense crown, making it easy to hide a person.
Lu Chuan used his hands and feet to reach the canopy of the tree in just a moment.
He covered his entire body with the branches and leaves of trees, revealing only a pair of sharp eyes.
After a while.
Several voices suddenly sounded from around.
"MD, where's the kid?"
"Look for it quickly!"
